name: print-social-royal-blue-designer-services-post-with-glass-folder
title: Blue gradient designer promo with tilted pill titles and a frosted folder holding post thumbnails
whatItIs: A blue radial-gradient 4:5 post with 'Social Media Flyer Designs' on tilted glass pills, a frosted translucent folder from which three post thumbnails peek, a cream info block with brand name, industry and typeface, and a designer avatar with contact line at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Modern and organised; the glass folder makes a portfolio feel like an object.
techniques: Tilt glass pills as a title.
Show work as thumbnails in a frosted folder.
List project facts in a small info block.

vocabulary.definition: A short list of project facts.
Small images showing above an edge.
